cases.purpose: Check the complete vendor gate, gate disabled, and exact structured PXE menu encoding.
cases.oracle: Fixed independent BOOTP field and option byte assertions.
cases.comparison: Offline responses to three vendor classes with gate on and off.

files.on.conf:
pool 192.0.2.100 192.0.2.150
netmask 255.255.255.0
server_id 192.0.2.1
next-server 192.0.2.99
tftp-server tftp.lab.test
bootfile pxelinux.0
pxe-discovery-control 8
pxe-boot-server 7 192.0.2.8
pxe-menu-item 7 "Boot Menu"
pxe-menu-prompt 3 Select
pxe-vendor-match on
files.off.conf:
pool 192.0.2.100 192.0.2.150
netmask 255.255.255.0
server_id 192.0.2.1
next-server 192.0.2.99
tftp-server tftp.lab.test
bootfile pxelinux.0
pxe-discovery-control 8
pxe-boot-server 7 192.0.2.8
pxe-menu-item 7 "Boot Menu"
pxe-menu-prompt 3 Select
pxe-vendor-match off

cases.script:
for mode in on off; do
  for vendor in none msft pxe; do
    dhcpd respond "$(< req-$vendor.hex)" -c "$mode.conf" -l "leases-$mode-$vendor" > "reply-$mode-$vendor.hex" || exit 1
  done
done
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/t057-dhcpd-pxe.py
